translation: E toda ⟨a⟩ congregação dos filhos de Yisrael saiu de diante de Moshé

tokens.rationale: vav-consecutive + they went out; rendered as 'E ... saiu' (past tense with vav-reversive)
all/every; requires article in Portuguese for natural reading
stated assemblage/congregation; 'multidão' or 'comunidade' would be alternatives but 'congregação' fits priestly context
sons/children; in collective context 'filhos' (of Israel) is the standard rendering
from before the face of; 'de diante de' captures the spatial relationship
Moshe; transliterated as Moshé following the discipline document
